name: What are the advantages of buying a new construction condo versus a resale condo?

mainEntity.name: What are the advantages of buying a new construction condo versus a resale condo?

acceptedAnswer.text: Buying a new construction condo typically offers modern designs, up-to-date building codes, new appliances, and often a warranty from the builder. You can also customize finishes and selections if you purchase early in the development phase. Resale condos, while potentially more affordable per square foot, may require immediate renovations or updates. Kelby Contreras specializes in new development in areas like Aventura and Sunny Isles Beach, helping clients navigate these choices and understand the unique offerings of each project.
acceptedAnswer.description: New construction condos offer modern designs, warranties, and customization options, while resale condos may be more affordable but might require updates.
